cause: The journal quality parser treated every level-one Markdown heading as Title, so conventional top-level headings such as # Abstract or # Methods were falsely reported as missing sections.
impact: Users or future report writers using one top-level Markdown heading per section could not produce an exportable journal report despite supplying all required sections.
lesson: Recognize explicit section names before applying the free-form-title fallback, and keep a regression test for top-level section headings.
